definitions.explanation: The amount of money paid regularly for the use of a house, apartment, or other residence.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.notes: {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ = to pay rent

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家賃|やちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{家賃|やちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧10⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The rent is 100,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{家賃|やちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くなる→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Rent goes up when you're close to the station, so I chose a place a little farther away.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧3⟦か{月|げつ}→ヶ月：00956_kagetsu⟧⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまい、⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧さん⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I fell three months behind on rent and received a warning from the landlord.
examples.notes: {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧する = to be behind on rent; ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ = landlord

notes:
USAGE: {家賃|やちん} is the everyday word for residential rent — what a tenant pays a ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ each month for a house or apartment. In contracts, and for office or commercial space, the more formal ⟦{賃料|ちんりょう}→賃料：30029_chinryou⟧ or ⟦テナント→テナント：23088_tenanto⟧⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ is used instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay rent)
- {家賃|やちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (rent is expensive/cheap)
- {家賃|やちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be behind on rent)
- {家賃|やちん}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (rent included, e.g. in a quoted total)

RELATED COSTS: when you sign a lease you normally also pay ⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧ (a refundable security deposit) and ⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧ (non-refundable key money) on top of the first month's {家賃|やちん}.
